# User-facing impact under kill faults

**POST-HOC DESCRIPTIVE -- not preregistered; no test added to any family.** Generated by `analysis/final/user_facing_impact.py`; every value below is computed by that script. Correlations in parts (c) and (d) are descriptive (Spearman's rho, no p-value).

## Quantity

`delta_error_rate = fault_error_rate - baseline_error_rate`. The fault-window error rate is end-to-end at the gateway (a trace counts as an error if any of its spans errored). The baseline error rate uses the gateway's own spans. The scopes differ, but the baseline error rate is 0.0 in 90 of the 90 kill runs, so the difference has no numerical effect: `delta_error_rate` equals the fault-window gateway error rate.
